map-lxxii-171.summary: An unsigned letter from the court of Castile to Lorenzo de' Medici, in the contributor's reading: the writer's last letter went through a merchant's house at Seville; a league 'a difensione degli stati' has been or will be concluded; the parties show 'sì poca fermeza'; someone is devoted to Lorenzo ('ve ne potete fidare') and a brother of his is the comendador mayor of Alcántara and the writer's close friend; an agreement with the queen is to be made; a betrothal, a legate, a tithe on the clergy of which one party 'tocha la metà'. Persons are code items and stay unread; the context (the peace of Alcáçovas, 4 September 1479) is the contributor's inference.
map-lxxii-171.en:
Complete line coverage of the surviving reading, not a complete decipherment.
Italics translate provisional clear handwriting. Question marks remain substantive;
unread words and code groups are preserved. Subject, tense, and antecedent are left
open where the Italian does not settle them. Editorial expansions are not extra
decoded signs. Consult reading.md and the literal decryption alongside this version.
